description: Source code for X509 v3 extension utilities in OpenSSL, including functions for managing extensions, retrieving extension data, and handling extension lists.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_add
methods.description: Adds a new extension method to the extension list, supporting ASN1_ITEM-based extensions.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_get_nid
methods.description: Retrieves an extension method by its NID, searching standard and custom extension lists.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_get
methods.description: Gets the extension method associated with a specific X509 extension.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_free
methods.description: Frees extension data based on its NID and data pointer.

methods.name: X509V3_add_alias
methods.description: Creates an alias for an existing extension NID.

methods.name: X509V3_add_standard_extensions
methods.description: Placeholder for adding standard extensions; currently a no-op.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_d2i
methods.description: Decodes an X509 extension into its internal structure.

methods.name: X509V3_get_d2i
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes a specific extension from a stack of extensions by NID.

methods.name: X509V3_add1_i2d
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension in a stack, with control flags for operation.
